column1: # The median seconds per step and OS of three check-core runs on main (#373): the baseline scripts/ci-times
# reads with --baseline (a step over max(floor(b * 1.3), b + 60) is a warning in the check-<os> jobs). Raised only by a
# pull request's own diff: scripts/ci-times on three main runs, then the new medians here. Runs: 42597596546, 42466515969,
# 42449662277, all on 13b7f4e, after the tests audit (#426: the trimmed sets and the rebalanced shards, PRs 545-554).
